name: Resolution payout → Mexico
sub: A market resolves; the winner in Guadalajara gets paid in pesos.

source.description: market #88213 resolved YES · position value USD 640.00 · pUSD unwrapped → USDC (Polygon)

facts.velocityDetail: first withdrawal > USD 500 · EDD-lite passed automatically

narratives.APPROVED: Resolution to local fiat in one hop, with the venue's licence, the beneficiary's jurisdiction and the KYC match all in the trace — the audit a bank partner asks for, produced by default.
narratives.VENUE_LICENCE_REQUIRED: Venue is unlicensed in the beneficiary's market. The router found no partner pairing with appetite for unlicensed event contracts.
narratives.JURISDICTION_OUT_OF_APPETITE: No partner pairing has appetite for this jurisdiction while state litigation is live (or a betting licence is required). Funds remain in the venue wallet.
